description: Server Actions for all mutations, localStorage-to-Supabase migration layer, Content Scanner DB upsert, and Question Import Pipeline improvements. Covers Tier 1 items #6, #7, #8, #11. Creates a data access layer that abstracts localStorage vs Supabase, with Server Actions as the mutation interface.
steps: Create src/shared/lib/data-layer.ts - a unified data access module that checks if Supabase/Prisma is available. If yes, use DB. If no, fall back to localStorage. Export functions: getUser(), saveNote(), getNotes(), saveAttempt(), getAttempts(), saveFlashcard(), getFlashcards(), saveProgress(), getProgress(), saveMistakeLog(), getMistakeLogs(), saveBookmark(), getBookmarks(), saveExamTarget(), getExamTarget(), saveSession(), getSession().
Create src/shared/actions/notes.ts - Server Actions: createNote, updateNote, deleteNote. Each calls data-layer, validates with Zod.
Create src/shared/actions/questions.ts - Server Actions: submitAnswer, createSession, completeSession, bookmarkQuestion, flagQuestion.
Create src/shared/actions/flashcards.ts - Server Actions: createFlashcard, reviewFlashcard, deleteFlashcard.
Create src/shared/actions/progress.ts - Server Actions: updateProgress, updateStreak.
Create src/shared/actions/mistakes.ts - Server Actions: classifyError, resolveMistake, createMistakeLog.
Create src/shared/actions/bookmarks.ts - Server Actions: toggleQuestionBookmark, toggleResourceBookmark, toggleNoteBookmark, savePageBookmark.
Create src/shared/actions/exam-target.ts - Server Actions: setExamTarget, getExamTarget.

Update src/features/content-scanner to add a DB upsert step: after scanning, if Prisma is available, upsert ContentResource records. Add a new file src/features/content-scanner/actions/sync-to-db.ts that reads content-index.json and upserts to content_resources table.

Update src/scripts/import-questions.ts to improve the pipeline: better PDF text extraction with pdf-parse, improved question parsing regex patterns, paired Q/A file correlation (match question PDFs with answer PDFs by filename pattern). Output parsed questions as JSON that can be bulk-inserted.
Create src/features/question-bank/actions/import.ts - Server Action to bulk import parsed questions into the questions table with proper topic/provider foreign keys.
Ensure all Server Actions validate inputs with Zod schemas and return typed ActionResult<T> responses.
acceptance_criteria: All Server Actions compile without TypeScript errors
Data layer correctly falls back to localStorage when DB is unavailable
Content Scanner sync action can read content-index.json and produce valid upsert operations
Question import pipeline handles PDF parsing and outputs structured question data
All existing tests continue to pass
verification: eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npx tsc --noEmit && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
